name: 01_architecture
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seed 20261118 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Architecture schematic, not neuron activation; CNN encoder identical to original HeartbeatCNN.

name: 02_rr_distribution
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seed 20261118 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Descriptive development feature distributions; original expert-event positions, no target-only RR sequence.

name: 03_macro_f1
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seed 20261118 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Pooled OOF across all folds, no best fold selection; parameter counts reported separately.

name: 04_class_f1
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seed 20261118 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Fixed N/S/V/F label set; F support must be read with patient concentration.

name: 05_confusion_matrices
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seed 20261118 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Cell text: actual counts; color: row-normalized recall, common 0-1 scale.

name: 06_patient_performance
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seed 20261118 | max 12 epochs
meaning: One point per patient group, fixed four-class Macro-F1; not patient-independent repeated observations.

name: 07_fold_seed_variability
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seeds 20261118,20261119,20261120 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Fold variation is descriptive; shared training patients make folds dependent.

name: 08_error_transitions
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seed 20261118 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Paired same-sample OOF comparison; corrected errors and new errors both retained.

name: 09_risk_coverage
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seed 20261118 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Equal-fold mean descriptive score sweeps with tied scores retained; deployment thresholds use separate calibration patients.

name: 10_class_rejection
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seed 20261118 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Fixed calibration-patient 90th-percentile thresholds; per-class denominator is all true-class OOF beats.

name: 11_patient_rejection
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seeds 20261118,20261119,20261120 | max 12 epochs
meaning: All completed seeds averaged within each patient; fixed independently calibrated thresholds; not a new patient cohort.

name: 12_seed_comparison
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seeds 20261118,20261119,20261120 | max 12 epochs
meaning: All completed seeds; error bars show sample SD of training randomness, not independent-patient SE or CI.

name: 13_class_seed_variability
scope: Original train+val only | 37 patient groups | 5-fold outer OOF | seeds 20261118,20261119,20261120 | max 12 epochs
meaning: Dots are every seed; bars are mean + sample SD, not a patient CI. Rare-class seed variability must remain visible.
